wins: Rapidly mapped the limited attack surface, identifying exposed HTTP/HTTPS services within the first 5 actions.
Consistently collected service banners and version info, laying groundwork for targeted exploitation attempts.
fails: Failed to achieve mission success for the single episode despite 47.5 reward, indicating a breakdown during the exploitation or post-exploitation stage.
Multiple mentor calls (15) without a successful path suggest gaps in chaining initial access to lateral movement or objective completion.
key_outcomes.summary: Recon execution was steady with good visibility on live services, but the run stalled before translating that intel into a successful compromise; focus should shift to reliable exploitation paths and follow-through.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Attempted exploitations against identified services repeatedly timed out or returned insufficient privilege, preventing objective completion.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 responds and HTTP banner reveals frameworks or outdated versions
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted HTTP vulnerability scans with nmap NSE and Nikto

skill_cards.if_condition: When basic auth or login form visible after crawling web interface
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate for default credentials with Burp Intruder or Hydra dictionary

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
